evidence_state: Decoded static destructive-operation contracts; no live-system claims

provider_resolution.runtime_map_fact: Both registration slots resolve to symbol CmdResetToDefault in the liboemcmds-owned table.

sharing_model: The two wire addresses have byte-for-byte identical dispatcher privilege/flags and bind the same exact function. The implementation contract is recorded once, with two registration overlays; no selector-as-operation inflation and no cross-BMC sharing are claimed.

request.length: exactly one payload byte; otherwise completion 0xc7

payload_byte_0.0xaa: asynchronous CfgResetConfigToDefaults(0xfffffffd,0), described by the binary as preserving network settings and user accounts; request-header byte0 high nibble 7 remaps this selector to 0xdd before the worker runs
payload_byte_0.0xcc: asynchronous CfgResetConfigToDefaults(0xfffffffd,0), described by the binary as preserving network settings and user accounts
payload_byte_0.0xdd: asynchronous CfgResetConfigToDefaults(0xffffffff,0), described by the binary as reset with user restored as shipped from factory (root/calvin or ToeTag)
payload_byte_0.0xee: asynchronous CfgResetConfigToDefaults(0xffffffff,1), described by the binary as reset with user restored to root/calvin
payload_byte_0.0xff: asynchronous CfgDAResetToDefaults(0,0), described by the binary as custom defaults

response.query_0x00: one byte: 0 when /var/lock/rtd/r2default.lock exists, 1 when stat of that path fails
response.accepted_action: one zero byte after successful detached-thread creation; this acknowledges scheduling, not reset completion
response.error: response length is not established by every early error path; no response payload is written

authorization_and_interface.internal: preChecks rejects with 0xd4 when local configuration is disabled and IsKcsCommand(request) is true; non-KCS requests do not take that rejection branch
authorization_and_interface.busy_lock: non-query actions reject with 0xd4 when /var/lock/rtd/r2default.lock exists
authorization_and_interface.firmware_update: non-query actions reject with 0xc0 while IsFirmwareUpdateInProgress is nonzero
authorization_and_interface.channel: No numeric channel rejection was decoded. Behavior is interface-sensitive through IsKcsCommand and request-header byte0 high nibble 7.

completion_codes: 0x00 query completed or detached reset worker successfully created
0xc7 request length is not exactly one
0xd4 local-config/KCS precheck failed or reset lock exists
0xff pthread attribute, allocation, or thread creation failure
effects: Every action selector is copied into a one-byte heap object and executed by detached threadResetToDefault; 0xaa can be remapped to 0xdd for one request-header class.
The worker calls StartRemoveJobsEvent before its reset backend.
Selectors 0xaa/0xcc, 0xdd, and 0xee invoke CfgResetConfigToDefaults with the exact masks/flags listed in the request map; 0xff invokes CfgDAResetToDefaults.
Backend failures occur after the command has returned success and are only logged by the worker.
implementation.activation: Static registration plus Administrator dispatcher privilege; non-query action predicates are local-config/KCS policy, reset-lock absence, and no firmware update.
implementation.runnable_codec: absent; deliberately fail-closed because all nonzero accepted selectors launch destructive asynchronous work

limits: The actual success/failure of the asynchronous reset backend cannot be returned by the command and was not measured.
Downstream implementations of imported reset APIs were not expanded in this bounded family pass.
No runnable codec is supplied for these destructive routes.
